focus: Repro and verify each open P1 (Gate 3 order asymmetry, ANCHORS_VALID phase-parent skip, check-goal corpus exit, create.sh template root, CROSS_ANCHOR_CONTAMINATION, resolveProjectRoot fallback, trigger-index staling); then compare system-spec-kit references docs against sk-doc's reference template on frontmatter and section shape.

label: Gate 3 order asymmetry CONFIRMED: 'Update the README and review the result.' returns triggersGate3=false with reason read_only_override, while 'Review the README and update it.' returns true with file_write_match. hasMixedWriteTail discards a write trigger that precedes the read-only token and the file-write branch then suppresses on any disqualifier.

ANCHORS_VALID phase-parent skip CONFIRMED with exit 0: a phase-parent spec.md carrying ANCHOR:outer wrapping ANCHOR:inner validates as level=phase, status=pass, message 'Phase parent lean document set accepted', passed=true, exit 0. The validator returns before scanning any anchor, so the v4.0.0.5 note's 'nested anchors fail validation' is false for phase parents.

check-goal corpus exit CONFIRMED by isolated repro: with --root pinned to a /tmp git repo holding one unfilled goal, check-goal.cjs --all reports criteria-count_findings=1 and parent-budget_findings=1 and exits 0. Only read errors move the exit, so --all is a report and never a gate. Running it in this repository exits 2 for read errors, which masked the defect in earlier iterations.

check-goal.cjs getDefaultWorkspaceRoot() is path.resolve(__dirname,'../../../../../') and main uses it for every branch, so --all resolves the workspace from the module's own location and not the caller's cwd: run from /tmp/v12-goalws it reported goals_scanned=1268 from this checkout, and only --root /tmp/v12-goalws reported goals_scanned=1. An override exists but --help lists no root line. This is the same module-relative failure resolveProjectRoot was introduced to fix for the compiled writer, unfixed in sk-doc's script.

CROSS_ANCHOR_CONTAMINATION CONFIRMED dead by producer search: rg -l contaminationPlan over .skilled returns exactly two files, the validator and its unit test, so no runtime path ever builds the plan and the skip branch is the only reachable branch on a real run.

resolveProjectRoot fallback CONFIRMED and the previous residual closed: usesSpecKit() tests existsSync(dir/.skilled/skills/system-spec-kit), so a project carrying specs/ but no vendored .skilled tree is classified as not using spec-kit and the writer targets the runtime repository with one stderr line. The predicate is defensible as a vendoring marker; the write-escape consequence is not, because the safe default is refusal.

create.sh template root CONFIRMED on re-read and the site count corrected to four, not three: TEMPLATES_BASE is built from $REPO_ROOT at lines 1477, 1665 and 2253 with the phase-parent template reusing it at 1666, while REPO_ROOT prefers the cwd's git top-level over find_repo_root $SCRIPT_DIR at line 1406. Half the script is location-relative and half is cwd-relative.

Trigger-index staling DOWNGRADED P1 to P2 with the mechanism replaced: index.manifestHash equals manifest.manifestHash (6172ddea...), so the shipped index was built from this manifest and is not stale, while corpusHash covers 28,548 included .md paths against 17,644 index paths and zero entries for this run's 047 packet. Research narratives are corpus-hash ballast, not index content: they move corpusHash without adding retrievable paths. manifestHash is a build receipt, not a coverage proof, and nothing compares corpusHash to anything.

sk-doc reference canon compared on five system-spec-kit references docs: frontmatter conforms on all five (6 of 6 fields, 4-part versions, valid contextType) and every file opens with '## 1. OVERVIEW' then numbered sections, so the frontmatter and section-shape limbs are clean. The divergence is title discipline: validation-rules.md has 9 H1s and save-workflow.md has 15 against sk-doc's single '# [Title]' contract, and retrieval chunks by heading so each H1 is a competing chunk root.

Extension: excluding specs/**/research/** from the corpus manifest costs zero index coverage, because 0 of the 047 packet's docs and only 224 of 19,551 specs paths appear in index.paths, and it stops corpusHash churning on every research iteration. A --check mode on the lookup would then be a single comparison of index.manifestHash to manifest.manifestHash, both already present.

direction: A --check (freshness) mode on lookup-trigger-index.mjs, and Q3's residual that retrieval-conventions.md should document its contract
reason: The lookup throws 'unknown argument: --check' and exits 2 for any unknown -- flag, and rg for '--check' over references/retrieval/retrieval-conventions.md and SKILL.md returns nothing. There is no contract to document, so the residual is a non-question; what is missing is the mode itself, not its docs.

direction: Frontmatter and section-shape misalignment between system-spec-kit references docs and sk-doc's reference template
reason: All five sampled docs carry the same six frontmatter fields with 4-part versions and valid contextType values, and all five open with '## 1. OVERVIEW' followed by numbered sections. The only divergence found is H1 multiplicity (9 and 15 in two files), which is a title-discipline defect rather than a template-shape one.
